utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Oh, got it—I’m out running errands, but keep me posted on how the repair drive’s going.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Will do, Ira—I’ll check in this evening with a clear update on what got fixed and what still needs doing.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Sounds good—I'll watch for your update tonight.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Yeah, I’m in for the repair drive—just tell me when and where.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Great—Saturday at 10 in my driveway. Bring any small appliances or tools that need fixing.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Sounds good—I’ll swing by Saturday at 10 with a couple of small things.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Are we definitely set on the repair drive, and do we know who’s actually showing up?

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: I’m fine with the repair drive, but I’d feel better once we’ve got a clear headcount and a list of who’s bringing tools.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Right, can we confirm the headcount first and who’s bringing what before we call it settled?

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Oh—right, the repair drive. I meant to bring my toolbox, but I can still help however I can.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: No worries, Oren—we can still use an extra pair of hands. I’ve got the basic supplies covered, so maybe help sort the donated parts?

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Right, sorting parts—I can do that. Just point me to the boxes, and I’ll try not to mix anything up this time.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Can you remind me which repairs we’ve already confirmed for the drive, Noah?

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Uh, I’m pretty sure we already confirmed the roof patch and Mrs. Alvarez’s fence, but I might be forgetting one.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Got it — the roof patch and Mrs. Alvarez’s fence for sure; before we add anything else, can we check the list and make sure there isn’t a third one already confirmed?

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Hey Jules, sorry I’m late—how’s the repair drive looking so far?

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: No worries, Dane—it’s going well so far. We’ve already got a good little pile of busted lamps and toasters, and a few folks from both blocks showed up to help.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: That’s great to hear—I can jump in wherever you need me, and I don’t mind starting with the lamps if that helps.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: I’m in for the repair drive, Gus—tell me what needs fixing and when to show up.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: That’s great, Sam—come by the lot Saturday at 9, and I’ll have a list of small fixes ready along with a few spare tools.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Sounds good, Gus—I’ll be there Saturday at 9 and bring my toolbox too.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: I’ve got the repair drive noted at the community center lot, and I can be there a little early to help keep things organized.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: That helps a lot, thank you. I’ll work around the school pickup window, but I can come by after drop-off to pitch in.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Perfect, I’ve got you down for after drop-off at the community center lot, and I’ll be there early to get the setup mapped out.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Oh, Quinn, I heard the repair drive’s shaping up nicely—folks keep dropping by to ask how they can help.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: That’s great to hear—I’ve been telling everyone on the block to swing by, and it sounds like the word’s really getting around.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: It surely is—Marta said she’s bringing extra tools, and I heard Sam might set up a table for spare parts too.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Rey, how many repair requests do we have so far, and what still needs volunteers?

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: I’m not sure of the total yet, but I’ve heard a few folks mention leaky faucets and one broken fence latch. I think we still need volunteers for basic plumbing and anyone with tools for small carpentry fixes.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Okay—can you get me a rough count by tonight, and who already said they can handle plumbing or carpentry?

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Hey Nell, there’s a repair drive coming up soon, and I’ve been telling folks so we can get a good turnout.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Oh, good to know—I’d only heard bits and pieces. When is it, so I can pass it along too?

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: It’s this Saturday morning at the community lot, so I’ve been telling everyone to spread the word. If you pass it along too, we should get a solid turnout.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Hi Uli, I’m glad we’re syncing up about the repair drive—can we go over what tools and volunteers we’ve got so far?

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Yeah, we can do that. I’ve got a basic toolkit, and I think a few neighbors said they might help if we keep it simple.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: That’s a great start, Uli—if you can confirm who’s in, I’ll make a simple list of volunteers and tools so we know what gaps to fill.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Oh, Eli, I heard the repair drive’s shaping up nicely—folks have been dropping off tools all morning.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: That’s good to hear. If we keep a clear list and set times, the whole repair drive should run smoothly.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Absolutely, and I can spread the word about the schedule so nobody shows up all at once.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Hey Vik, sorry I’m late—how’s the repair drive going?

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: It’s going well so far—we’ve got a good turnout, and I’ve been telling everyone the repair drive’s moving along nicely.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Glad to hear it—I figured I’d roll in a little late, but I’m here now, so just point me where I’m needed.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: I heard a little about it, but not much yet—what needs fixing first?

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Probably the heaters and a couple of roofs first. Folks are trying to keep it practical.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: That makes sense. If you hear who needs a hand first, let me know and I can stop by quietly.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Sure—what still needs fixing for the repair drive?

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: I’ve got three spots still on the list: the bench by Maple Park, the loose fence panel behind the community garden, and the flickering light at the bus stop on Cedar.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Got it—bench, fence, and that bus stop light. Which one do you want me to handle first?

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Hey Hana, I’m glad you asked about the repair drive — I’ve been pulling a few folks together, and I think it could really help if we spread the word.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: That sounds promising—what date and location are you planning so I can share the right details?

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: I’m aiming for next Saturday at the community center lot, but I’m just waiting on the final okay this afternoon. Once it’s confirmed, I’ll send you the exact time so you can share it around.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Oh—right, the repair drive. I meant to ask, are we still meeting by the community shed for it?

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Yep, we’re still meeting by the community shed for the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Got it, by the shed—thanks. I’d probably have shown up at the garden gate otherwise.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Oh, got it—how’s the repair drive coming along so far?

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Pretty well, actually—folks have been dropping off all kinds of fixable stuff, and I’ve been lending out my tools left and right.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: That’s great to hear—sounds like people are really showing up for it. Need me to spread the word while I’m out?

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: I’m happy to help with the repair drive—what do you need me to take care of first?

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Thanks, Sam—can you start by sorting the donated tools and setting aside anything that still works well?

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Absolutely—I’ll sort through the donated tools and pull out the ones that are still in good shape.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: I’m okay helping, but how are we actually collecting and sorting the repairs without it turning chaotic?

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Good question—who’s keeping the list, and can we sort requests by type and urgency before the day starts?

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: That’s exactly what I’m worried about—we need one shared list and someone assigned to triage by urgency and tool type before anyone shows up.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Cleo, we should turn the repair drive into a block event and invite everyone tonight.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: That could work, but let me check what supplies we actually have first so we don’t overpromise.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Totally, check the supplies and I’ll start getting the word out so folks can save the evening.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: I can help with the repair drive, but I need to work around school pickup and drop-off times.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: That helps a lot, Faye—thanks. I always muddle the times, so just tell me what window works around pickup and drop-off and I’ll make a note.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: I’m free between about 9:30 and 1:30 after drop-off and before pickup, so that’s the safest window to put me down for.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Hi Nell — I’m pulling together the repair drive list this week, so if you’ve got any fixes to flag, send them my way.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Oh, thanks, Rosa — I’ve only heard bits and pieces, but I’ll ask around and pass along anything folks mention.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Perfect, thank you — I’m hoping to have a clean list by Friday, so anything you hear before then would really help.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Rosa, do you know exactly which street the repair drive is set up on?

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Yes—it's set up on Maple Street, right by the community garden.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Got it—Maple Street by the community garden. I’ll note that down for the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: I only heard bits and pieces—what’s the latest on the repair drive?

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: It’s coming together fast—we’re doing a neighborhood repair drive this Saturday, and I’ve been telling everyone to swing by. If you want, I can put you down and loop you in on the details.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Oh, yes please—put me down and send me whatever details you have, since I’ve only been hearing it second-hand.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: I’ve got a running list of spare screws, tape, and gloves for the repair drive—tell me what you still need, and I’ll check what’s on hand.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Thanks, Cleo. I still need a small set of screwdrivers and maybe a pair of work gloves if you’ve got extras.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: I can set aside a pair of work gloves for you, and I’ll check whether we’ve got a small screwdriver set in the supply bin this afternoon.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Oh right, the repair drive—I meant to ask if we still need more volunteers for Saturday.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: I think we might, but I’d like to check the current list first—do you know how many people have already signed up for Saturday?

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Ah, shoot, I don’t remember the number offhand—sorry. Want me to go check the signup sheet with you?

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Hey Noah, I can help with the repair drive, but I need to work around school pickup and drop-off times.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Oh, right, thanks — if you tell me your pickup and drop-off windows, I’ll try to fit the repair drive around them.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Thanks, Noah — school drop-off is around 8 to 8:30, and pickup is 2:45 to 3:30, so I’m easiest to schedule between those times.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: I can bring my drill and a couple extra screwdrivers for the repair drive, if that helps.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: That helps, thanks. I’ll stop by for a bit and do what I can.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Perfect — I’ll set those aside, and if you’ve got work gloves, bring them too.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Oh, good timing — I’m out running errands, but tell me how the repair drive’s shaping up.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: How many volunteers do we actually have confirmed, and did anyone lock in the tool drop-off spot yet?

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: I haven’t heard the latest headcount yet, but I can check once I’m back; last I knew, the tool drop-off spot still wasn’t locked in.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Morning, Vik — what’s the plan for the repair drive, and what do you need from me?

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Morning, Eli — the plan is to meet by the community shed at nine, sort the tools, and then split up for the repair drive. I need you to bring the extension cords and remind the others of the plan too.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Sounds clear — I’ll bring the extension cords and let the others know we’re meeting at the community shed at nine to sort tools before we split up.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: I’m happy to help with the repair drive, Tess—just tell me what needs doing.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Oh, that’s kind of you, Sam—right now we mostly need folks to sort donated tools and make a quick list of who can handle pickups.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: I can sort the donated tools this afternoon, and I’ll put my name down for pickups too if that helps.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Hey Leo, sorry I’m late—how’s the repair drive going so far?

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Going alright so far—steady trickle of folks, and we’ve fixed a few bikes and lamps already.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Nice, sounds like I didn’t miss the whole thing then—where do you want me to jump in?

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Hey Bo, are we still on for the repair drive this weekend?

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Yep, still on as far as I know—I'm a little slammed, but I can make time this weekend.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Great, thanks for making the time—I'll bring the signup sheet and a box of basic tools.
